THE order under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act, No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.

By virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act, No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, the Minister of Environment do by this Order declare the state land of the extent 402.11 hectares located in the area bounded by the limits set forth in the Schedule given below, as Rajagala Reserved Forest from 15th day of July 2025.
At the Bajjangoda Open Air Theatre in Gampaha District,15th July, 2025.

The land area surrounded by the straight lines formed by joining the starting point (Eastern Coordinates 207508, Northern Coordinates 229839) up to the final point (Eastern Coordinates 207511, Northern Coordinates 229841) and from there again upto the starting point (Eastern Coordinates 207508, Northern Coordinates 229839).

By virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 63 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act, No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I do by this notification notify that the Rajagala Reserved Forest mentioned in the above order is subjected to the sole control of the Conservator General of Forests.
At the Bajjangoda Open Air Theatre in Gampaha District,15th July, 2025.
